statement.notes: The field 'depreciation_and_amortization' was directly mapped from the line item 'Depreciation, amortization, and other' in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash from operations' section of the cash flow statement. No other elements from the provided data were required to make up this field. The supplementary tables contain detailed breakdowns of intangible assets and lease amortization, but these are not part of the consolidated cash flow line item.
